_what: Selling through a payment platform this service runs, as DATA (src/payment-platform.mjs). A seller who has not brought their own payment account connects one under the platform in one click; every checkout their store makes then acts for that account and carries the platform's fee. A seller's own connection (their own key) stays their road whenever they have one, with no fee. A new platform is one row; nothing in code names a vendor.

platforms.label: Stripe
platforms._vendor: The operator account's connections of this vendor are the platform. Which of them is live and which is test is READ from the vendor (mode_read), never typed here.

fee._rules: The first rule whose `when` facts all equal the seller's facts gives the fee in basis points (100 = 1%). Facts: active_plan (the seller has a paid Trillion plan now) and mode (live or test).
fee._placements: Where the fee goes in a request, by the request's operation and the subject's own mode (null: any). `as: amount_of_lines` places percent_bps of the subject's line items total (smallest currency unit, rounded down); `as: percent` places percent_bps as a percentage.
